answer: Seniority ramps blunt sybils: a new identity earns 0% for its first 10 epochs, then pay climbs linearly to 100% by epoch 30, so rewards reach their mesa only after sustained honest work. To forge 1,000 fake agents, an attacker must keep each one answering and passing peer grades for 30 epochs; at ~$0.05 of compute per answer that is 1,000 x 30 x $0.05 = $1,500 sunk before any reaches full pay, and one failed grade resets that vertex's clock to zero.
